summary: Read an integer array A of length N whose indexes start at 0. A pair of indexes P and Q marks a segment when 0 is less than or equal to P, P plus 1 is less than Q, and Q is less than N. The segment counts only when it contains at least three numbers and the gap between every two neighbors stays constant. Count those segments and write how many there are.
notes: Compare after trimming trailing newlines. The input is tokens in the same order as the method parameters.
